protocol.name: TEP · independent mode 1 benchmark
protocol.declaration: Fixed before scoring. Faults 1, 3 and 5 retain distinct response patterns, including weak detection. All results and failures are retained. No fault-test model or threshold selection.
limitations: Public process simulation, mode 1 only; not plant measurements.
Two runs per fault are descriptive and do not support population confidence claims.
Quantile calibration on one normal run does not guarantee a held-out false alarm budget.
Adaptive Max-Z is experimental; statistical contributions are not causal diagnoses.
